Class HomeScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<TUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.TUIScreen
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.HomeScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<TUIScreen>, InputEventVisitor
public class HomeScreen extends TUIScreen
Non-blocking home menu rendered with TextGraphics. Lets the player create or join a game and stays in sync with HomeUpdateEvents as new active games are announced by the server. Transitions to LobbyScreen on LobbyUpdateEvent.

      public HomeScreen(TuiTerminal terminal, AppCoordinator coordinator, String username, List<Integer> activeGames, Map<Integer, List<String>> gamePlayers, Map<Integer,Integer> gameCapacity)
      Parameters:
      terminal - the TUI terminal used for rendering
      coordinator - the coordinator used to send create/join/logout requests
      username - the current player's username
      activeGames - ids of games currently open for joining, or null if none
      gamePlayers - per-game list of player names already joined, or null
      gameCapacity - per-game maximum number of players, or null
